   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  April 13, 2026

Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. and Commissioner Sanchez led the Flag Salute.
Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Lopez, Commissioner Garcia, and Commissioner Sanchez.
Also present was Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Rosalee Santa Ana, Sr. Management Analyst,
and Laura Zaldivar, Community Information Assistant.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes
for March 9, 2026. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Native Garden Contest

Ms. Ocegueda presented the contest timeline, with a May 1 launch and June 8 Commission review.
The Commission agreed to award one winner per category for the inaugural year. Staff will continue
efforts to secure prize incentives.

PastForward Series

Ms. Ocegueda presented the first video in the series. The Commission received the update and
provided general support for continuing quarterly video releases.

Keepin’ It Norwalk

Ms. Ocegueda reported on recent business spotlight results and ongoing video production. The
Commission received and filed the update.

Community Band

Ms. Ocegueda presented survey results indicating community interest. The Commission supported
continued outreach and survey collection at upcoming events.

Communications Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana presented monthly performance metrics across digital platforms. The Commission
received and filed the report.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Ms. Ocegueda provided updates on merchandise procurement, Brown Act requirements related to
group site visits, and planning for the June 12 Commissioners’ Meet and Greet Dinner. Direction was
given to explore cost-effective catering options.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
April 13, 2026

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioners commented on recent City events, noting strong attendance and community
engagement.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:18 p.m.

_____________________________

David Ang, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
